title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content: Cover image: Moltrecht’s treefrog (Zhangixalus moltrechti) is a treefrog endemic to Taiwan, characterized by its jade green coloration and vivid orange patches on the inner surfaces of its hind limbs. Although this beautiful species is widespread and abundant throughout Taiwan, our findings reveal that its low-elevation populations may be particularly vulnerable to climate change. Photo by: Chia-Chien Hung
